Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1998
ORDINANCE V OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 30th March, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(V)/98, dated 30-3-1998.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the day the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997 (XXXIII of 1997) stands repealed under
Article 128(2) of the Constitution.

Amendment of section 4-A of Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE V OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1998
ORDINANCE V OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 30th March, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(V)/98, dated 30-3-1998.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information:---
2. Amendment of section 4-A of
Act XXX of 1975.---In the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of
1975) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 4-A the following
shall be substituted:---
"4-A. Vice
Chairman.--(1) The Government may designate from amongst the members not
more than two Vice-Chairmen of the Authority.
(2) A
Vice-Chairman shall perform such functions as may be assigned to him by the
Authority.".

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE V OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1998
ORDINANCE V OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 30th March, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(V)/98, dated 30-3-1998.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information:---
3. Amendment of section 7 of
Act XXX of 1975. In the said Act, in section 7, for subsection (2) the
following shall be substituted :--
"(2) The meetings of the
Authority shall be presided over by --
(i) the Chairman;
(ii) in the absence of the
Chairman the Vice-Chairman;
(iii) in case there are more than
one Vice-Chairmen, in, accordance with such priority as may be determined by
the Authority; and
(iv) in the absence of the
Chairman as well as the Vice-Chairman by a Member of the Authority elected for
the purpose by the Members present, from amongst themselves.".
